doc.title: surf
doc.body: Sound effect only: About eight seconds of ocean shore ambience: rolling waves swell, break gently in scattered sprays, and draw back across wet sand. Continuous natural bed. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: marsh
doc.body: Sound effect only: About eight seconds of quiet marsh water: infrequent soft laps, gas bubbles rising through mud and occasional little plops. Continuous natural bed, no frogs. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: frog
doc.body: Sound effect only: A nearby marsh frog gives two or three short raspy croaks, each pulsing from its throat, the last lower. Isolated animal call, no ambience. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: hit
doc.body: Sound effect only: A short, solid melee blow lands on a creature: muffled body impact with a small bright edge and quick decay, without a weapon swing. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: hit-great
doc.body: Sound effect only: A powerful melee blow lands on a creature: heavier low body impact, sharper bright crack and brief satisfying decay. One impact only. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: struck
doc.body: Sound effect only: Another hero receives a melee blow nearby: a solid but somewhat distant body impact, quick dry decay. One hit only. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.

doc.title: swing
doc.body: Sound effect only: One quick unarmed or light-weapon swing misses through air: a brief soft swish that dies immediately. No impact. No speech, words, music, or other sounds.
